fields.Name: IT165 - Collaborative Docs, Slides, Sheets & Working States over GraphQL and WebSocket
fields.Description: Client-transport companion to IT164. Proves over the GraphQL and WebSocket wire against a live MJAPI: (DSLC1) MJ: Artifact Working States is unreachable over GraphQL; (DSLC2) a restricted read-only user's MJ: Artifact Versions Save() is refused by MJArtifactVersionEntityServer over the API; (DSLC3) MintArtifactCollaborationTicket + WebSocket upgrade to /collaboration/yjs succeeds and a read-only peer's write frame is rejected with readonly-rejected; (DSLC4) ExecuteDocumentLiveBlock denies EntityView and Artifact blocks when the caller lacks read access.
